wetBoundary.wetFace: Continuous sealed metal upstand and mechanically retained front splash leaf. Raised drawer above flood level is a removable maintenance piece with no fault credit. Independently wet all leaf joints, controls and upper support penetrations under the actual source-fed pressure case.
wetBoundary.bothPipeOutletsBlocked: The independent broad open daylight route is available only with free reception. Keep its cleaned throat/outside outlet physically separate from both small pipes. Walkway and outside approach are never permitted receiving areas.
wetBoundary.allOutletsBlocked: No configuration here contains a source-fed failure indefinitely. When the direct spill edge or receiving land is also blocked or saturated, reject the plot or redraw a truly external wet bay with a broad safe exterior spill. No response time, pump, safety-discharge or roof-water path is credited.

pressureScreen.scope: Simple strip bending comparator for a normally stopped ideal jet, not a measured flow, adopted supply pressure or whole-panel, latch, seam or spray rating.
